def _ls(a, b):
    return np.linalg.lstsq(a, b, rcond=None)[0]

reusable_ast_function_closures.code:
def _operator(study, x):
    a = study['panel_a']
    (u, v) = (a['u'], a['v'])
    (offsets, scales) = ([], [])
    for j in range(u.shape[1]):
        d = _aff(u[:, j:j + 1])
        q = _ls(d, v[:, j])
        for _ in range(8):
            keep = np.argsort(abs(d @ q - v[:, j]))[:int(len(u) * 0.875)]
            q = _ls(d[keep], v[keep, j])
        err = abs(d @ q - v[:, j])
        keep = err <= max(10 * np.median(err), 0.002)
        q = _ls(d[keep], v[keep, j])
        offsets.append(q[0])
        scales.append(q[1])
    b = study['panel_b']
    return _aff((x - offsets) / scales) @ _ls(_aff(b['u']), b['v'])

def solve_batch(study):
    (tr, te) = (study['train'], study['test'])
    w = _operator(study, np.concatenate((tr['x'], te['x']), axis=0))
    y = 0.35 * _predict(w, tr['y'], True, 'asinh') + 0.65 * _predict(w, tr['y'], True, 'atan')
    p = _predict(w, tr['traj'], False, 'inv3')
    tail = p[:, -1]
    return {'y_hat': y, 'state_pred': p, 'diagnostics_vec': np.array([y.mean(), y.std(), tail.mean(), tail.std()])}

def _coordinates(study, x):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    from scipy.optimize import root
    panel = study['panel_a']
    (u, v) = (panel['u'], panel['v'])
    magnitude = np.linalg.norm(v, axis=1)
    med = np.median(magnitude)
    mad = np.median(np.abs(magnitude - med))
    keep = magnitude <= med + 10 * max(mad, 1e-06)
    basis = _cal_basis(u)
    for _ in range(3):
        coef = np.array([_ls(basis[keep, j], v[keep, j]) for j in range(u.shape[1])])
        residual = np.linalg.norm(np.sum(basis * coef, axis=-1) - v, axis=1)
        keep = residual <= max(10 * np.median(residual), 0.001)

    def forward(z):
        return np.sum(_cal_basis(z) * coef, axis=-1)

    def inverse(row):
        fit = root(lambda z: forward(z) - row, row, tol=1e-10)
        if np.max(np.abs(fit.fun)) > 1e-07:
            from scipy.optimize import least_squares
            fit = least_squares(lambda z: forward(z) - row, row)
        return fit.x
    z = np.array([inverse(row) for row in x])
    p = study['panel_b']
    return _aff(z) @ _ls(_aff(p['u']), p['v'])
